# Corpus speed ratio: portal vs pinned Reference

**calibration-unqualified (ADR-0024).** Generated by `scripts/corpus_speed_ratio.py` (fm-5wq.35, schema `fmn.speed-ratio` v1). Ratio = portal wall time / Reference wall time, paired per interleaved repetition, median per scene. Below 1 means the portal is faster. Not PG-1 evidence. Skip mode differs by design (BN-10): the portal runs every frame's updaters, the Reference one step per skipped segment.
